近正视 · 东汉建安十四年

This is NOT two free-standing independent gate towers. Preserve its exact unequal outline, main rectangular shaft made of four stone courses with shallow stone-carved columns, elaborate stepped interlocking bracket-like blocks above the shaft, a low carved frieze immediately below its single broad stone hip-roof cap, and the small attached ear tower's single lower stone roof. The small tower's roof sits approximately at the level of the bottom of the main bracket assembly. Preserve the actual worn roof profile, slightly curved tile-shaped stone eaves, existing tall central ridge-end profile, visible stepped corner blocks and a few representative relief figures in very spare contour. Keep existing broken edges and the visible large central joint/gap in the bracket assembly, do not reconstruct missing carved pieces. Remove all inscriptions.
Create refined sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. All surfaces WHITE. Fine outer contours with even finer structural lines. No black shadow fills, no grey wash, no crosshatching, no pencil texture, no dense stonegrain or brick patterns. Architectural structure matters more than reproducing every carving. Do not add a second complete eastern que or any pavilion.

site_recommendation.name: 高颐阙
site_recommendation.place: 四川 · 雅安 · 雨城
site_recommendation.lede: 雅安汉碑路旁，高颐墓前的石阙将汉代木构形制凝在红砂岩中。西阙保存着主阙与耳阙相连的高低轮廓。
facts: 建于东汉建安十四年（209），为益州太守高颐墓前的仪仗建筑。
原为东西双阙，西侧子母阙保存较完整；图版按实照绘西阙，不复原残损东阙。
石阙以斗栱、楼部和屋檐模拟木构，雕刻中兼见历史故事、神兽与出行题材。
